name: Warhost's Frenzy — a kicker sentence that is not a continuous effect does not gate the boost
notes: Guard for the kicker work: 'Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, whenever a creature you control dies this turn, draw a card.' The kicked sentence stays in place; it must not turn into a condition on the +2/+0. That is why the kicked condition is an internal bracketed token ('[additional cost paid]') written only by _splitConditionalBranches rather than readable oracle wording: a mid-line 'If <readable condition>,' gates its whole line. Unkicked, Bears are 4/2.
